opening: I have a painful open sore on my right leg.
It started as a small red spot.
My feet are swollen, and pressing on the swelling leaves a dent.
I have swollen, twisted veins in both of my lower legs.

opening.text: I have a painful open sore on my right leg that's been there for a month; it started as a small red spot. My feet are swollen, and pressing on the swelling leaves a dent. I also have swollen, twisted veins in both of my lower legs. I have type 2 diabetes and I take insulin, and I have Crohn's disease.
